name: Dixon Technologies

snapshot.about: Electronics manufacturing services (EMS) company producing mobile phones, home appliances, lighting, consumer electronics, telecom equipment and IT hardware.

narrative: Revenue growth remains strong, with top-line expanding 46.7% YoY in Q2 FY27 to ₹21,794 crore. However, net profit dropped 44.9% YoY to ₹411 crore, while FY26 mobile volumes missed target at 32 million units against 40-42 million promised.

promises.statement: Company targets 40 to 42 million mobile phone volumes in FY26.

said.quote: So, we feel that this year numbers are going to be similar, 40 million, 42 million

actual_source.quote: We have closed at almost 32-odd million in the current fiscal

promises.note: Closed FY26 with around 32 million smartphone units against 40 to 42 million target.

promises.statement: Company expects to close FY26 mobile phone exports at INR 5,500 crore to INR 6,000 crore.

said.quote: We feel we should be closing at almost INR5,500 crores, INR6,000 crores in the current fiscal

actual_source.quote: In the present -- in the last fiscal, the exports was approximately INR5,375 crores
